adjudication.rationale: Verified in diff: `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` only checks `request.referer` host against `SiteSetting.embeddable_host` (and does not validate `params[:embed_url]` host). In `best`, when no topic exists it enqueues `Jobs::RetrieveTopic` and renders `loading`. The retriever (`TopicRetriever#invalid_host?`) instead validates the host of `@embed_url` (the param) and will skip retrieval if it doesn't match `embeddable_host`. This mismatch means a request with an allowed referer but a different/non-embeddable `embed_url` will pass the controller, the job will no-op, and `app/views/embed/loading.html.erb` will keep reloading every 30s indefinitely.
